summary: Defines Augmented BNF, a compact notation for writing the syntax of protocols and message formats. It separates this definition out of the early email specifications so that others can cite it, with some changes and additions. It was replaced by RFC 4234.

eli5.summary: It is a way of writing rules for what a message must look like, such as which parts come first, like a grammar for computers.

questions: how to write protocol syntax rules
